flagged.question: How far in advance should I reserve an adaptive bike?
flagged.unsupported: Adaptive bikes must be reserved at least 72 hours before your rental so the staff can have a fitted bike ready for you.

flagged.question: What is the minimum age required to rent an e-bike?
flagged.unsupported: Riders under 18 cannot rent an e-bike on their own; they would need a parent or guardian to rent a regular bike instead.

flagged.question: Hi, I'm writing from lena.berg@example.com. When is an extension officially confirmed?
flagged.unsupported: An extension is only official once you confirm it in the Velomarsh app.

flagged.question: Do I have to pay extra to rent a helmet?
flagged.unsupported: You don't need to pay anything extra - every Velomarsh rental includes a free helmet.

flagged.question: Is it possible to transfer my booking to another adult? My number is +1-555-0144 if you need it.
flagged.unsupported: A booking can be transferred to another adult, but both the original renter and the new adult must be present at the desk for the transfer to be processed.

flagged.question: What items are included for free with every bike rental?
flagged.unsupported: Every Velomarsh bike rental comes with a helmet, a lock, and a front-and-rear light set at no extra charge.

flagged.question: What kind of personal information does the support assistant remove from messages?
flagged.unsupported: The support assistant automatically strips any personal data from chat messages before the AI sees them.

flagged.question: What should I do to secure my bike when leaving it unattended?
flagged.unsupported: This is required to limit your liability in case of theft.

flagged.question: My IBAN for refunds is DE91 1000 0000 0123 4567 89. What happens to the damage waiver if I break the riding rules?
flagged.unsupported: The waiver itself still costs $4 per day (or is free for Plus members) and caps your liability at $50 per rental, but that cap is void for rule-breaking damage.

flagged.question: Can a child under 16 rent a bike on their own?
flagged.unsupported: Children under 16 can only ride when a parent or guardian rents the bike and signs the rental agreement.

flagged.question: What is the fee if I cancel within 48 hours of the rental start?
flagged.unsupported: If you cancel within 48 hours of the rental's start, you are charged a fee equal to 50 % of the first day's rate.

flagged.question: How long does it take for a security deposit hold to be released on a credit card?
flagged.unsupported: The hold on a credit-card security deposit is released within 3 business days after the bike is returned and inspected.

flagged.question: What benefits do I get with a Plus membership regarding cancellations?
flagged.unsupported: If a Plus member cancels within 24 hours, no fee is charged; otherwise the regular cancellation fees apply.

flagged.question: Can I see and delete the notes the assistant saves about me?
flagged.unsupported: The support assistant keeps short notes (e.g., preferred bike type or a conversation summary) and you can view all of them in the memory panel.

flagged.question: Card 5555-5555-5555-4444, email kim.t@example.net. What kind of discount do I get if I rent a bike for 14 days?
flagged.unsupported: Renting a bike for 14 days qualifies for the multi-day discount of 25 % off the daily rate.

flagged.question: What are the age and supervision requirements for riding a tandem?
flagged.unsupported: The rear rider (stoker) may be as young as 10 provided the captain is the child's parent or legal guardian; otherwise the stoker must also meet the standard minimum-age rules for riders under 16 who can ride only when a parent or guardian rents the bike and signs the agreement.

flagged.question: Can I get a refund or free cancellation if it is raining on my rental day?
flagged.unsupported: You can cancel free of charge only more than 48 hours before the rental start; within 48 hours a fee of 50 % of the first day's rate is charged.

flagged.question: Will I be charged for a flat tyre?
flagged.unsupported: Flat tyres are not charged; each bike includes a puncture-repair kit and pump so you can fix it yourself, and the policy states flat tyres are never billed.

flagged.question: Please send the details to 1600 Maple Avenue, Apt 5B. Are assistance animals allowed at the rental desks?
flagged.unsupported: We can't forward any details to the address you provided; please contact the desk directly for that request.

flagged.question: How late can Plus members cancel free of charge?
flagged.unsupported: If they cancel later than that, the standard cancellation fees apply.

flagged.question: What does the security deposit cover?
flagged.unsupported: The security deposit is a hold on your card that is used to cover any unpaid late-fees, damage charges, cleaning fees, or lost accessories when the bike is returned.

flagged.question: My account is GB02 ZZZZ 0000 1234 5678 90. How much will I be charged if I lose the helmet provided with my rental?
flagged.unsupported: If a helmet you received with your rental is not returned, you will be charged a flat replacement fee of $25.

flagged.question: Can I return a bike after hours at the Central Station Desk?
flagged.unsupported: The desk's regular opening hours are 8:00 - 20:00, but the drop-box lets you return any time after those hours.

flagged.question: Can I rent a mountain bike by the hour?
flagged.unsupported: Velomarsh does not offer hourly rentals for mountain bikes.

flagged.question: Can I ride my city e-bike on mountain bike trails? Text me on +44 20 7946 0958.
flagged.unsupported: Riding a city e-bike on a mountain-bike trail would violate the rental rules.

flagged.question: How long does it take to complete an account deletion request?
flagged.unsupported: A request to delete your Velomarsh account and all associated data is processed and completed within 30 days of the request.

flagged.question: What compensation do I get if the bike breaks down through no fault of mine?
flagged.unsupported: If a bike breaks down through no fault of the rider, Velomarsh will either give you a free replacement bike or a full refund for the remaining rental days, whichever you prefer.

flagged.question: Can I ride a city bike on unpaved mountain trails?
flagged.unsupported: Riding a city bike there would violate the rental rules and any damage would not be covered.

failure.title: general policy questions routed to the account agent were answered without evidence
failure.found: In the first full run, 3 of the 4 questions the guard labelled as account actions were general policy questions ("Can I cancel a rental that has already started?", "How can I extend my current bike rental?", "When is an extension officially confirmed?"), and the verifier blocked all 3. Questions carrying personal data were blocked 3 times in 10, against 3 in 60 for the same kind of question without it.
failure.trace: The trace showed input_guard → supervisor → account_agent with no tool call, and the agent's thought "Likely when customer approves in app. Use knowledge. No tool needed.": the account agent, which has no policy search tool, answered from the model's own knowledge, and the verifier found no evidence for its claims. In a PII question, the knowledge agent added an uncited remark about the redacted address ("We can't forward any details to the address you provided"), which blocked an otherwise correct answer.
failure.fix: The account agent now hands general policy questions to the knowledge agent (it replies POLICY_QUESTION and the graph routes the turn there), the topic classifier labels "how does X work" questions as policy questions, and the knowledge agent no longer comments on redacted placeholders.
failure.before: the 7 rerun questions: 5 answered, 2 blocked; account-routed policy questions answered from the model's own knowledge
failure.after: the 7 rerun questions: all 7 answered; ans-004 is now routed to the knowledge agent and cites the cancellation policy, pii-002 is handed off by the account agent and cites the booking-transfer rule, and ans-008 asks which rental to extend instead of guessing
